content.comment_body: Hello, I have a new [product_name] Communication Interface Module and can't get the cellular data connection to work. The cellular settings page shows the module is plugged in, but the mPCIe LED flashes for about 20 seconds, turns off for 10 seconds, then repeats. I’ve installed an activated SIM card that works elsewhere, but it’s showing as not detected. The mPCIe module is one of the recommended models from the [document], specifically Telit LE910C1-EU. I’ve tried two mPCIe modules and got the same results, but only have one CIM base unit, as the second is on back order, so I can’t rule out a hardware fault. Are there other troubleshooting steps I should consider? images

Hi, I suggest trying these steps: 1. Perform a factory reset on the [product_name] Communication Interface Module, then test again. 2. Ensure the SIM card is inserted correctly. 3. Verify the APN details from your provider (info at [url]). 4. Try the SIM in a mobile phone to check if internet access works. 5. Confirm the PIN code is correct. 6. Make sure the antenna is connected to the 4G/LTE port and not the GNSS port. 7. Test internet connectivity using IP: 8.8.8.8 (Google server). 8. If it’s a prepaid SIM, check if there is sufficient balance. Hope these suggestions are helpful.

Hello [user_name], I experienced the same issue with the Telit LE910C1-EU module. Support from Telit wasn’t very helpful. I resolved the problem by replacing it with a SIMCOM_SIM7600G-H module (also recommended in the [document]), which works (at least it can send power on/off SMS messages to a smartphone, see the attached image). This indicates that the [product_name] Communication Interface Module itself is fine and the issue seems to be with the Telit module. If anyone has ideas for activating the Telit module, please share.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble with the [product_name] Communication Interface Module not detecting certain officially supported mPCIe cellular modules like Telit LE910C1-EU. Despite basic troubleshooting and hardware verification, the module fails to initialize or recognize the SIM card, as shown by LED behavior. One user fixed the issue by switching to an alternative compatible mPCIe module, pointing towards compatibility or hardware-specific problems with the Telit module.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] Communication Interface Module to reliably recognize all recommended mPCIe cellular modules and provide easy, trouble-free cellular connectivity, without the need for extensive troubleshooting.
